nodes.label: Production app service (Thruster + Puma + Solid Queue)
nodes.rationale: Runs db:prepare, ledger:genesis and ledger:release_models before exec'ing Thruster, so a fresh host comes up with a genesis entry and released models without a manual step; TLS_DOMAIN drives Let's Encrypt inside the container.

nodes.label: Production db service (postgres:16 + pg_stat_statements)
nodes.rationale: pg_stat_statements is preloaded because it is how a running node answers 'which statement is costing us', which no Ruby profile can say.

nodes.label: cloudflared tunnel profile
nodes.rationale: A named Cloudflare tunnel terminates TLS and reaches app:80 inside the compose network, so a home node needs no router changes and no open ports.
